Quick start ​

Try a sample or paste your own writing to generate an analysis profile and QR-inspired SVG code in the browser. The SVG includes the full profile as versioned metadata so it can be shared and read back into the package. Use writeLikeMe(prompt, profile) for a basic local template-based draft, or use compareTextStyle to compare another draft with a reference sample. Neither function calls an AI service.

Try it with your own text

Text stays in your browser. See the estimated profile, then copy the JavaScript or download your QR-inspired style code.

Preparing the browser analyzer…

These are lightweight dictionary and text-shape heuristics, not an AI assessment. Results can be inaccurate, especially for short text or languages other than English.

To use the same API in Node.js, install the package and run:

Install ​

bash
npm install @ai-clyde/writelikeme
javascript
const WriteLikeMe = require('@ai-clyde/writelikeme');
const fs = require('fs');

const text = 'A short sample paragraph.';
const profile = WriteLikeMe.analyzeText(text);
const svg = WriteLikeMe.generateStyleSVG(profile);
fs.writeFileSync('writelikeme-code.svg', svg);

Explore the installation guide, API reference, style-code and local-writing guide, and examples for more details.
